reports.title: [0.1.22] Agent.run(timeout_seconds=...) cannot extend the 300 s brain turn budget, and the budget stop is returned as a normal reply
reports.summary:
The Agent.run() timeout parameter is ignored - the turn stops at 300 seconds regardless of the timeout value passed, and returns a misleading stop message instead of raising a proper timeout error. This prevents users from extending the brain turn budget beyond the 300s default limit.

When using output_type=SomeModel, the issue surfaces as an invalid JSON AgentOutputValidationError instead of a clear timeout exception, masking the actual problem.
reports.suggested_next_action: Investigate the root cause in runtime.brain_turn_timeout_seconds handling and ensure Agent.run respects the timeout_seconds parameter passed by users
